events.title: Chopin Preisträger
events.intro: The eighth evening of the Meisterpianisten series celebrates the 100th anniversary of the Chopin Competition, which has launched legendary pianists such as Maurizio Pollini, Martha Argerich, and Krystian Zimerman. The program features solo piano works by Schumann, Chopin, and Schubert.

events.title: Cornamusa - World of Pipe Rock and Irish Dance
events.intro: Award-winning dancers and a seven-piece live band bring 'Im Schatten der Krone' (In the Shadow of the Crown) to life in a captivating show full of emotion, rhythm, and artistic expression.

events.title: SWR Symphonieorchester: Dans la cuisine du chef
program: Joseph Haydn: Sinfonie Nr. 101 D-Dur ("Die Uhr")
events.intro: An open rehearsal with chief conductor François-Xavier Roth, where he invites the audience to explore the unique recipes of great masterworks, uncovering the layers and ingredients that composers like Haydn used to craft their works.

events.title: Bee Gees by Maincourse: Europas größte Bee Gees Tribute Show
events.intro: Bee Gees by MainCourse brings Europe's biggest Bee Gees tribute show to the Beethoven-Saal, recreating the timeless hits of the Bee Gees with the energy and power of a live band performing today.

events.title: Staatsorchester Stuttgart: 7. Kammerkonzert - Film ab!
program: Nino Rota: Trio für Klarinette, Violoncello und Klavier
Ralph Vaughan Williams: Phantasy Quintet für Streichquintett
Erich Wolfgang Korngold: Klavierquintett E-Dur op. 15
events.intro: A chamber concert themed around film music featuring works by Nino Rota, Ralph Vaughan Williams, and Erich Wolfgang Korngold, exploring the intersection of cinematic and concert music traditions. The program ranges from Rota's lyrical Clarinet Trio to Korngold's passionate Piano Quintet op. 15.
